chapterInfo.content:
2
Odiyifoɔ no frɛ
1Na ɔka kyerɛɛ me sɛ: Onipa ba, sɔre gyina wo nan so, na me ne wo nkasa. 2Na ɔrekasa akyerɛ me no, honhom bi baa me mu, na ɛmaa me so gyinaa me nan so, na metiee deɛ ɔne me kaeɛ no. 3Na ɔka kyerɛɛ me sɛ: Onipa ba, meresoma wo Israel mma nkyɛn, ɔman atuatefoɔ a wɔate m’anim atua no nkyɛn; wɔne wɔn agyanom na afom me de bɛsi nnɛ da yi. 4Wɔyɛ aniɛdenfoɔ a wɔapirim wɔn akoma; me na meresoma wo wɔ wɔn nkyɛn, na woaka akyerɛ wɔn sɛ: Sei na AWURADE Nyankopɔn seɛ. 5#Hes 3.11, 27 Na sɛ wɔtie oo, wɔantie oo, (ɛfiri sɛ abusua atuatefoɔ ne wɔn nti), ɛnyɛ dɛn ara a, wɔbɛhunu sɛ odiyifoɔ bi aba wɔn mu. 6Na wo, onipa ba, nsuro wɔn, na nsuro wɔn nsɛm nso, na nsansono ne nkasɛɛ ne wo na ɛwɔ hɔ, na anyanyankyerɛ ho na woteɛ, nanso nsuro wɔn nsɛm, na mma w’akoma nntu wɔ wɔn anim; na wɔyɛ abusua atuatefoɔ. 7Na wɔtie oo, wɔantie oo, ka me nsɛm kyerɛ wɔn, na wɔyɛ atuatefoɔ.
8Na wo, onipa ba, tie deɛ mereka akyerɛ woɔ yi, nyɛ atuateni sɛ atuatefoɔ fie yi; bae w’anomu, na di deɛ mede merema woɔ yi. 9#Adi 10.8-11 Mehwɛe, na hwɛ, nsa bi atene hwɛ me so, na hwɛ, na nwoma mmobɔeɛ wɔ mu. 10Na ɔtrɛɛ mu wɔ m’anim, na wɔatwerɛ emu ne akyire, na wɔatwerɛ mu kwadwom, apinisie ne mmusuo.

Na ɔka kyerɛɛ me sɛ: Onipa ba, sɔre gyina wo nan so, na me ne wo nkasa. Na ɔrekasa akyerɛ me no, honhom bi baa me mu, na ɛmaa me so gyinaa me nan so, na metiee deɛ ɔne me kaeɛ no. Na ɔka kyerɛɛ me sɛ: Onipa ba, meresoma wo Israel mma nkyɛn, ɔman atuatefoɔ a wɔate m’anim atua no nkyɛn; wɔne wɔn agyanom na afom me de bɛsi nnɛ da yi. Wɔyɛ aniɛdenfoɔ a wɔapirim wɔn akoma; me na meresoma wo wɔ wɔn nkyɛn, na woaka akyerɛ wɔn sɛ: Sei na AWURADE Nyankopɔn seɛ. Na sɛ wɔtie oo, wɔantie oo, (ɛfiri sɛ abusua atuatefoɔ ne wɔn nti), ɛnyɛ dɛn ara a, wɔbɛhunu sɛ odiyifoɔ bi aba wɔn mu. Na wo, onipa ba, nsuro wɔn, na nsuro wɔn nsɛm nso, na nsansono ne nkasɛɛ ne wo na ɛwɔ hɔ, na anyanyankyerɛ ho na woteɛ, nanso nsuro wɔn nsɛm, na mma w’akoma nntu wɔ wɔn anim; na wɔyɛ abusua atuatefoɔ. Na wɔtie oo, wɔantie oo, ka me nsɛm kyerɛ wɔn, na wɔyɛ atuatefoɔ.
Na wo, onipa ba, tie deɛ mereka akyerɛ woɔ yi, nyɛ atuateni sɛ atuatefoɔ fie yi; bae w’anomu, na di deɛ mede merema woɔ yi. Mehwɛe, na hwɛ, nsa bi atene hwɛ me so, na hwɛ, na nwoma mmobɔeɛ wɔ mu. Na ɔtrɛɛ mu wɔ m’anim, na wɔatwerɛ emu ne akyire, na wɔatwerɛ mu kwadwom, apinisie ne mmusuo.

app.t1_copy: I've bookmarked passages that are important to me. I've even read the whole thing through in a year thanks to the reading plans.
app.t2_copy: I love how you are able to connect with friends and the Bible reading plans are awesome. This application helps me also to stay consistent in reading because it has reminders for the plans. It also gives me another way to come closer to God. Download this and read every day!
app.t3_copy: Great app with a wide selection of Bibles to choose from. ... The audio Bibles are also wonderful and easy to understand.
app.t4_copy: Many translations and languages available, and many that can be downloaded to read offline. Many useful features, such as the ability to make notes and bookmarks.
app.t5_copy: I love how it has a lot of versions and that there are verses of the day, devotions, plans and community. Thanks for this free app. :)
app.t6_copy: Great because there are many different versions and I could download multiple versions for offline reading. I'm able to listen to this app.
app.t7_copy: Helps me to read the bible more. Love the search and share features and the variety of ways to share. Also like the audio versions.
app.t8_copy: This is a great tool for studying from multiple translations. It's also convenient for listening to the bible when you're driving.
app.t9_copy: This is the best bible app out there. It has the word in different languages and versions for online and offline use. It has devotionals for everything you could think of. You can connect with others and ultimately learn about God and his Word.
